SE_initial.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production 2D game sprite atlas, neutral idle plus a TRUE alternating walk cycle for Passe-Rive.
Input 1 is the exact 3D POSE AND LAYOUT GUIDE. Input 2 is the accepted painted character STYLE AND COSTUME reference only; discard its old poses and bow-in-hand.
Create ONE SQUARE 1536x1536 transparent PNG with exactly FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, 12 separate full-body drawings, same grid and root positions as input 1. Every character stays entirely inside its own cell with generous transparent margins.
The entire sheet faces screen SE, bottom-right, viewed from above at 30 degrees. Same camera and same adult anatomy in every pose. Keep angular IVORY MASK, narrow dark eyes, petrol hood and tunic, sage shoulder mantle, ivory sash, gold clasp/bracers/anklebands, black gloves/puffed sleeves/trousers/boots. Match painted cel-shading and clean dark contours of input 2. NO BOW OR DAGGER IN EITHER HAND; both hands relaxed and empty. Equipment is stowed; quiver stays on the back.
ROW 1 = four identical stable neutral standing guard poses, matching input 1 row 1. Feet planted at shoulder width, elbows relaxed, arms naturally lowered, fingers slightly curled. No stepping, crouching or raising arms. Keep the exact same feet, head, body size and root placement across these four drawings.
ROWS 2 AND 3 = eight ordered consecutive phases of ONE COMPLETE TWO-STEP WALK, follow each corresponding 3D guide pose, no repeating the same leading leg. Frame4 left foot contacts ahead / right foot behind. Frame5 left planted down/compression. Frame6 left support under hips, right knee lifts and passes it. Frame7 right leg swings ahead. Frame8 RIGHT FOOT CONTACTS AHEAD / LEFT FOOT BEHIND (opposite of frame4). Frame9 right planted down. Frame10 right support under hips, LEFT KNEE lifts and passes it. Frame11 left leg swings ahead toward frame4. Arm swing opposes the legs. Clear difference between wide contact poses and narrow passing poses. Root stays on the same cell axis; natural small pelvis rise/fall; no skating, hopping or direction changes.
CRITICAL: preserve each corresponding guide's foot placement and arm silhouette. Frame4 and frame8 must have OPPOSITE legs leading, frame6 and frame10 OPPOSITE knees raised. Do not generate eight variations of one walking stance.
Genuine RGBA transparency. No background, floor, shadows, labels, grid lines, arrows, motion trails, extra limbs, weapons in hands or cropped tips. These are final painted sprites, not rendered 3D.
